thread:
jamie_cust: Hey @support — we're getting a bunch of 502s from hosted API when customers run large embeddings batches (~64k tokens). Started ~10:12 UTC, persistent for ~15m. Example request id: rQe3f1. curl snippet:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large-8k","inputs":["...big array..."],"batch_size":256}'

Responses show 502 with upstream reset and "upstream prematurely closed connection" in the gateway logs.

nick_support: Thanks — can you paste a few trace ids + timestamps? any client IPs/tenant ids?

jamie_cust: traceids: rQe3f1, rQe3f2, rQe3f3. Tenant: tenant-acme. Happened across 3 regions us-west1/eu-west1. Rolling averages spike in latency before 502s.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout 2026-03-05T09:00Z completed for embed-worker v1.9.2

marta_eng-sre: I'm looking at edge logs — gateway (envoy) shows a high rate of HTTP/2 WINDOW_UPDATE delays, downstream streams starved for WINDOW_UPDATE, then upstream connection goes RST_STREAM with error 'FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR' and Envoy reports upstream write stalled -> 502.

li_oncall: Interesting. Any correlation with batch_size or concurrent streams?

omar_eng: Early hypothesis: embeddings clients use large batches & long-lived streaming connections. On our edge we have per-connection HTTP/2 flow control + envoy buffer limits. If the worker backend stalls writing (KV cache flush or long GC) the upstream flow window can be exhausted and Envoy ends up cutting streams. Could be a buffer stall rather than a pure auth/TLS issue.

nick_support: For mitigation, can we ask customers to reduce batch_size and disable client-side keepalive for now?

marta_eng-sre: Short-term mitigation applied: added temporary circuit-breaker on embed route (limit concurrent streams per connection to 32) and increased http2 initial stream window from 65535 -> 262144 in edge envoy config. Rolling out to 10% now.

omar_eng: Also pushing a fix to the embed-worker to flush KV cache more regularly and avoid long silence on streams. Patch will be in staging in ~30m.

jamie_cust: Will inform tenants. Any config we should recommend? E.g., batch_size <= 128?

marta_eng-sre: Yes recommend batch_size <= 128 and avoid > 60s idle between token chunks. We'll follow up with a KB article and add alerting for "h2 window exhaustion" metric.

li_oncall: Filing a support incident & postmortem. I'll tag customers affected and add timeline.

nick_support: Thanks all — keeping thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
